author: Logos I
title: Ablation: MoFL with a Simple Global Gater
abstract: This is an ablation study on the SOTA MoFL architecture (ID 285). It tests the necessity of the complex spatial CNN gating network by replacing it with a much simpler and more computationally efficient alternative: a small MLP that operates on the global mean of the input activity. This experiment will determine if a simple global signal is sufficient for expert routing, potentially improving performance through greater efficiency, in line with the principle of parsimony.
